description: I live the life I want because I am flexible and always willing to readjust the plan 🥂 #designyourlife #selfdiscovery #selflove
transcript: I live the life I want, because I'm always willing to readjust. I am always willing to be flexible. There is nothing that comes my way that is not come to benefit me. There's nothing that comes my way that is not come to give me a leg up to flourish. I am always willing to move and move quickly, because I know that movement opens a door for something greater. There isn't a door that hasn't opened, that hasn't given me access to a more full life. I live the life I want, I live a full life, because I am flexible.
